name: Fullstory MCP
description: Ask questions of Fullstory behavioral data from Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor: build funnels and segments, review sessions, and find where users struggle. For product teams.

skills.name: Segments, Metrics, Funnels, Journeys
skills.description: Builds and computes segments, metrics, funnels, and journeys from natural-language questions, saving each result as a draft.

skills.name: Sessions Behind A Metric
skills.description: Pulls the real sessions behind any metric or segment and reads a full event transcript of what happened in each one.

skills.name: Agentic Session Review
skills.description: Inspects what a user actually saw at a given moment in a session, using rendered screenshots and accessibility snapshots.

skills.name: StoryAI Opportunities
skills.description: Surfaces where users are struggling, ranked by impact, with frustration signals, errors, and regressions, and a bot flag.
